g.text: Title: Rev C step 4 - hardware enable and reset gating

g.desc: Title: Rev C step 4 - hardware enable and reset gating

g.text: POWER_OK = SYS_OK . PACK_OK; MODE_OK = RUN_LATCHED . SERVICE_OK; ANA_ENABLE = POWER_OK . MODE_OK. Schmitt-input AUP gates.

g.desc: POWER_OK = SYS_OK . PACK_OK; MODE_OK = RUN_LATCHED . SERVICE_OK; ANA_ENABLE = POWER_OK . MODE_OK. Schmitt-input AUP gates.

g.text: ADS_RESET_N = ANALOG_OK . DIGITAL_OK . ADC_RESET_REQUEST . ANA_ENABLE. Any monitored fault resets the ADC without firmware.

g.desc: ADS_RESET_N = ANALOG_OK . DIGITAL_OK . ADC_RESET_REQUEST . ANA_ENABLE. Any monitored fault resets the ADC without firmware.

g.text: Requests and permits read low (off) while the MCU is in reset or unpowered.

g.desc: Requests and permits read low (off) while the MCU is in reset or unpowered.

g.text: HARDWARE ANALOGUE ENABLE AND ADC RESET GATING

g.desc: HARDWARE ANALOGUE ENABLE AND ADC RESET GATING

g.text: Restart after a fault needs a new RUN_REQUEST edge: see the restart_latch sheet (Step 10).

g.desc: Restart after a fault needs a new RUN_REQUEST edge: see the restart_latch sheet (Step 10).

g.text: PACK_OK gates the analogue rail only; the digital rail stays up for shutdown and service. Pack cell protection remains independent.

g.desc: PACK_OK gates the analogue rail only; the digital rail stays up for shutdown and service. Pack cell protection remains independent.
